result.description: Marketing automation platform for email, SMS, flows, segmentation and customer data.
result.auth_detail: Private API key (pk_..., Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key) for server-side; OAuth2 auth-code + PKCE (Bearer) for apps; public 6-char company ID for client-side /client endpoints.
result.access_detail: Free plan exists (250 profiles, 500 emails/mo). Private keys created in Settings > API keys by Owner/Admin/Manager. Docs state no plan restriction, but not explicit for free tier. OAuth apps self-created in Klaviyo; App Marketplace listing needs review + 5 installs, not needed for private use.
result.api_notes: REST with JSON:API conventions, versioned via revision header, OpenAPI spec at github.com/klaviyo/openapi. Covers profiles, lists, segments, events, metrics, campaigns, flows, forms, reporting. Per-API scopes (e.g. profiles:read, lists:write). Rate limited with 429. Full resource list not verified from fetched pages.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
When setting up OAuth, you must provide designated scopes for each API authorization request you'll want to make.
Log in, grab your API credentials, and start developing.
Up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails per month
If you do not use an API key for your requests, or if you use a key from the wrong account, your call will return an error.
Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
Our server is compatible with any MCP client that supports remote servers.
